metadata.name: Terman-Wang
metadata.author: Terman, D. & Wang, D. L.
metadata.description: Two-state LEGION relaxation oscillator with cubic fast dynamics and tanh-gated recovery

extensions.silicon_cosim_note: Over 8000 steps, hand model, schema runner, and Q16.16 RTL produce 0, 1, and 3 upward crossings at I=-1.0, 0.0, and 0.5 respectively. The transcendental tanh gate makes spike count, rather than bit-identical state, the portable parity observable.
